text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: An in-depth exclusive interview?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they said they want to capture us just being our usual selves.
Yeah, they said they want to film us going about our everyday routine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume at the center of her era and her Trainer.
It seems to be a TV program pitch about exploring their untold days, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Heh, takes all kinds, I suppose.
...Well, why not? Might as well give it a shot.
choice_data_list: I'll reply to them with an OK, then.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Coming right up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the day of the interview.
The film crew arrived at the academy, but—
choice_data_list: (Stay Gold... isn't here!!)

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text: Um, should we try again another day...?
choice_data_list: No! I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I halfway expected this to happen. So—
choice_data_list: I'm heading over to Stay Gold now.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness...! So you knew
where Stay Gold-san was all along,
Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: No, I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Still, it should probably be fine!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...??"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
choice_data_list: Stay Gooold!!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text:
Y-You've gotta be kidding me... They were really here...
It's barely an hour's drive from the academy, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
...Wait—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah~. Was today the day for the interview?
My bad, my bad, totally forgot.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was surprised.
Did you actually have where we were going
shared with you beforehand?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
I'm always like this.
choice_data_list: I'm always searching for it.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It was an exclusive behind-the-scenes coverage, right?
Then let's get straight to it—

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Could you be doing secret training off-campus...!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Time to eat.
choice_data_list: How about soba? I saw a nice place earlier.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, nice. Let's go, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Director
text_block_list.text: S-So this is the duo leading the charge of this new era...

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Even after that, the two of them continued in perfect harmony, enjoying every moment as it came."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘Inseparable friends’ must be the very phrase
to describe the two of them. We caught a glimpse
of the bond behind their great achievement—"
choice_data_list: (In the end, it just looked like a simple walk...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that wrapped things up nicely—
Well, this feels more like me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Besides, it's not like I told any lies.
choice_data_list: Well... that's true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"……Little did they know at the time that this footage would become
a hot topic among fans after the broadcast, leading to widespread calls for a sequel――"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“――Um... as far as I know,
I think the two of them are always like that.
Living each and every moment to the fullest, so to speak――”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "They get along super well! You can always hear the two of them laughing together!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, we know full well!
That the two of you are connected by a powerful bond!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"The two of you are 'fellow travelers on a journey~.'
No matter how far apart you are,
you are always looking in the same direction~."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—As you can see, there are countless people
within the academy who speak of
the deep bond of trust between them.”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘Inseparable friends’ must be the very phrase
to describe the two of them. We caught a glimpse
of the bond behind their great achievement—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, to think even Suzuka and the others
are doing interviews.
choice_data_list: Everyone was saying the exact same thing...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is a fact.
There's no problem with that, right?

text_block_list.text: And so, the broadcast aired without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Man. Stay Gold and the Trainer are so on the same wavelength, like real partners in crime. So this is what a best partnership looks like...

text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold's trainer really is a bit eccentric, huh?
Though I guess that's exactly why they're such a great match.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Some time after the broadcast aired.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Huh.
I had no idea people were talking about that so much."

text_block_list.text: Haha. Everyone really is full of curiosity, huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next time how about you film me going off to some uncharted land?
We'll meet up on-site, of course.

text_block_list.text:
—Still, having those around us view the way we are
favorably doesn't feel bad at all.

It became an event that reaffirmed
that both felt the exact same way—
